summary: Added click analytics: ClickEvent entity, bounded ClickQueue, ClickRecorder background writer, enqueue in the redirect handler, stats endpoint and DTOs; registered the queue and hosted service.

files.reason: Bounded channel between redirect and writer (ADR-5).
Batch writer with retry and graceful drain.
Clicks DbSet, composite index, cascade FK.
Enqueue click in RedirectAsync; new GetStatsAsync route.

risks: Existing v1 databases lack the Clicks table because EnsureCreated does not migrate; documented in README/CHANGELOG.
assumptions: Eventual consistency for stats is acceptable (Q2 default).
